主要内容: On January 2, 2015, Medallion Financial Corp. issued a press release announcing the death of its board member, Governor Mario M. Cuomo. The press release was included as Exhibit 99.1 in the Form 8-K filing. The company's press release was part of its disclosure obligations under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing was signed by Brian S. O’Leary, the Chief Operating Officer of Medallion Financial Corp., on January 2, 2015. The event was reported as an 'Other Events' item under Item 8.01 of the Form 8-K. The press release provided details about the passing of Governor Cuomo, who was a member of the company's board of directors.
